project_name: WorkPulse - Employee Tracking & Activity Monitoring Platform
theme: Dark / Light system with high clarity data density

layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: MODE B: High Density Grid (gap-4 md:gap-6)
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-lg for buttons/inputs, rounded-full for status indicators
layout_and_spacing.sticky_header: h-16 border-b border-border bg-surface/80 backdrop-blur-md sticky top-0 z-40 px-6 flex items-center justify-between

visual_enhancers.monitoring_active_banner: bg-emerald-900/30 border border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-300 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between shadow-lg shadow-emerald-950/20 animate-pulse-subtle
visual_enhancers.card_style: bg-surface border border-border rounded-xl shadow-sm hover:border-slate-700 transition-colors duration-200
visual_enhancers.status_pill: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium tracking-wide

key_features_and_pages.description: Centered professional login box supporting Admin, Manager, and Employee credentials with role-switcher demo buttons for immediate testing.
key_features_and_pages.components: Centered Card, Input fields, Remember Me, Role Switcher Demo Pills, Submit Button with spinner

key_features_and_pages.description: Real-time workforce command center with KPI summaries (Total Staff, Logged In, Active, Idle, On Break, Avg Hours), Monitoring Status Bar, Live Employee Grid with real-time mouse/keyboard activity indicators, and Attendance Heatmap/Chart.
key_features_and_pages.components: Metric Cards, Live Employee Status Grid, Interactive Activity Meter, Monitoring Indicator, Attendance Trends Chart

key_features_and_pages.page_name: Clock In / Clock Out & Break Bar
key_features_and_pages.description: Interactive employee timer widget supporting Shift Start (Clock In), Take Break, Resume Work, and Clock Out with active duration counter and real-time mouse/click tracker.
key_features_and_pages.components: Action Buttons, Live Duration Counter, Realtime Event Counters (Clicks, Mouse, Keys), Monitoring Active Banner

key_features_and_pages.description: Filterable employee directory table with edit drawer, role assignment (Admin, Manager, Employee), reporting manager dropdown, work schedule selector, and per-user Screenshot Toggle switch.
key_features_and_pages.components: Data Table with Pagination, Filters & Search, Edit Employee Drawer/Modal, Screenshot Switch Toggle, Role Badges

key_features_and_pages.description: 4-step wizard: 1. Drag & drop CSV/XLSX file with template download links. 2. Data Preview & Row-level validation errors highlight. 3. Confirm Import with summary counts. 4. Historical import logs table.
key_features_and_pages.components: Drag-and-Drop Dropzone, Sample CSV/XLSX Download Buttons, Data Validation Table with Red Error Rows, Import Summary Modal, Import History Log

key_features_and_pages.description: Session tracking log displaying login/logout timestamps, total duration, missed logout flags, and an interactive hourly timeline of active vs idle blocks and keystroke/mouse velocity.
key_features_and_pages.components: Session Table, Missed Logout Warning Badge, Hourly Visual Bar Timeline, Idle/Active Filter, Activity Heatmap

key_features_and_pages.description: Authorized Manager view of periodic screen captures organized by employee, date, and hour. Includes lightbox preview, blur option for sensitive content, 30-day auto-deletion notice, and tamper-proof audit log trail.
key_features_and_pages.components: Gallery Grid with Timestamp Overlays, Lightbox Dialog, Manager Authorization Guard, 30-Day Auto Delete Banner, Filter by Employee & Date

key_features_and_pages.description: Comprehensive daily/weekly/monthly productivity reports with filters by department, manager, date range, and export options to CSV and Excel.
key_features_and_pages.components: Date Range Picker, Department Selector, Summary Metrics, Interactive Recharts (Work Duration vs Idle Time), Export Buttons (CSV/XLSX)

key_features_and_pages.description: System configuration for idle threshold (e.g., 5 mins), screenshot capture frequency (e.g., 10 mins), 30-day retention rule notice, and desktop agent download links (Windows, macOS, Linux) with installation key.
key_features_and_pages.components: Config Sliders/Selects, Transparent Monitoring Policy Notice Box, Download Buttons with OS Icons, License Key Copy Input

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all key interactive components (buttons, links, form inputs, role switchers, table rows, modals, navigation tabs) include clear data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='clock-in-button', data-testid='employee-role-select').
Use Lucide icons (lucide-react) across all navigation and dashboard stat cards.
Implement Sonner toast notifications for actions like Clock In/Out, CSV Import validation, Screenshot Toggle changes, and Report Exports.
Provide demo dataset seed including 12+ realistic employees across 4 departments (Engineering, Product, Marketing, Sales) with active, idle, break, and offline states.
Ensure screenshot gallery views check for role authorization (Manager or Admin) and feature explicit 30-day retention transparency notice banners.
Support full CSV and XLSX parsing/validation for the Bulk Import wizard using PapaParse or XLSX utility, displaying exact row numbers for validation errors.
Include quick mock role switcher in the top navigation or auth page so reviewers can easily switch between Admin, Manager, and Employee modes.
